name: Role Fundamentals
description: Understanding the three core PvP roles — Tank, Healer, and DPS — their responsibilities, positioning, and how they interact in skirmishes, battlegrounds, and arenas.
subject: World of Warcraft: The War Within

name: Crowd Control
description: Using and responding to abilities that restrict enemy actions — stuns, roots, silences, slows, and fears. Includes understanding Diminishing Returns (DR) to avoid wasting CC chains.
subject: World of Warcraft: The War Within

name: Cooldown Management
description: Tracking and timing offensive and defensive cooldowns — knowing when to pop them, when to save them, and how to react when the enemy uses theirs. Includes PvP Trinket usage.
subject: World of Warcraft: The War Within

name: Positioning
description: Staying in range to deal damage or heal while minimising exposure to enemy attacks. Covers Line of Sight (LoS), kiting, pillar play, peeling, and general spatial awareness in PvP.
subject: World of Warcraft: The War Within

name: Target Switching
description: Identifying and switching to priority targets to maximise pressure. Includes recognising which enemy to train, when to swap for a kill, and communicating switches in group PvP.
subject: World of Warcraft: The War Within

name: Awareness & Tracking
description: Monitoring enemy cooldowns, health, and position during a fight. Includes tracking CC durations, recognising enemy burst windows, and adjusting play based on what the enemy has used.
subject: World of Warcraft: The War Within

name: Team Composition
description: Understanding how different class and spec combinations synergise in arena or battlegrounds. Includes recognising win conditions based on your comp versus the enemy comp.
subject: World of Warcraft: The War Within
